mainTitle: ⚖️ Slander about Email Threats: The False Accusation
mainDescription: Investigation of the false accusation of threats — This article examines the slander committed by Chronus when he falsely accused the user WazzimaGiygg (Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres) of sending threatening emails, without presenting any evidence, and the coordination between administrators and checkusers to validate the accusation and justify arbitrary sanctions.
section1Title: 1. Introduction: The False Accusation as a Tool of Persecution
section1Text1: The accusation of email threats is one of the most serious episodes of slander documented in the WazzimaGiygg case. Chronus, an administrator of Lusophone Wikipedia, falsely imputed to the user the crime of threat (Art. 147 of the Penal Code) without presenting any evidence of the allegedly sent emails. The accusation was made publicly, in a verification request, exposing the user to humiliation and defamation before the entire community.
objective1: • Document the false accusation of email threats
objective2: • Analyze the slander perpetrated by Chronus
objective3: • Examine the coordination to validate the accusation
objective4: • Frame the conduct under Art. 138 of the Penal Code
warningSlanderText: Chronus falsely imputed to the user the crime of threat (Art. 147 of the Penal Code) without presenting any evidence of the allegedly sent emails. The accusation was made publicly, in a verification request, constituting consummated slander (Art. 138 of the Penal Code), with a penalty of detention of 6 months to 2 years, plus a fine.
section2Title: 2. The False Accusation of Email Threats
sub2_1Text1: On February 12, 2026, Chronus opened a verification request against the account "Senhorvinte", which was one of Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres's (WazzimaGiygg) legitimate accounts. The request was made with the following justification:
chronusRequestText:
"First and only edit exposes my personal name in an attempt to spread distrust against me, as per other puppets:

[Link to the edit that supposedly exposed Chronus's personal name]"
criticalAnalysisList: No mention of threatening emails: The verification request does not mention any threatening email.
No evidence presented: Chronus did not attach any email or other evidence.
Vague and generic accusation: The allegation of "attempt to spread distrust" is subjective and does not constitute a crime.
Personal motivation: The request appears to have personal motivation ("exposure of my personal name").
sub2_2Text1: The image below documents the abusive verification request made by Chronus, which initiated the coordinated persecution against the user:
figcaption1:
Evidence 1 - Abusive Verification Request
Chronus falsely accuses the user of email threats, without presenting any evidence. The request was made on February 12, 2026.
evidenceWarningText: The image documents the abusive verification request made by Chronus. The accusation of email threats is made without any evidence, constituting slander (Art. 138 of the Penal Code). The image is conclusive proof of the false accusation.
section3Title: 3. The Coordination to Validate the False Accusation
sub3_1Text1: Chronus's verification request was followed by the "Little Sunshine" coordination pattern already documented in this dossier:

coordinationTable.action: Opens request against "Senhorvinte", exposing personal name and falsely accusing
Replies "Possible, difficult to prove with certainty due to the various resources used to hide the data"
Moves the request and "confirms" the relationship between the accounts

step3Text: Moves request and "confirms" in 6 hours what was only "possible"
patternConclusion: The coordination is evident and documented - Chronus's slander was validated and hardened by Little Sunshine to justify the block.
sub3_2Text1: Edmond Dantès, a checkuser, responded to Chronus's request with a cautious technical analysis:
edmondResponseText: "The relationship is possible considering geographical factors, but it is somewhat difficult to prove with certainty due to the various resources used to hide the data from previous puppet accounts. I have already blocked the account due to its sole purpose of attack."
edmondAnalysisList: "Possible" is not "certainty": Edmond Dantès acknowledges there is no certainty.
"Difficult to prove with certainty": Admission that the evidence is weak.
"Various resources used to hide": The claim of concealment is not evidence.
Already blocked the account: The decision was made before Little Sunshine's confirmation.
sub3_3Text1: Little Sunshine, a checkuser, "confirmed" the relationship between the accounts in just 6 hours:
sunshineResponseText:
"Confirmation with WazzimaGiygg - Little Sunshine
Little Sunshine → out.ar 11:45 on February 13, 2026 (UTC)"
sunshineAnalysisList: 6 hours: Insufficient time for a minimally serious technical analysis.
Contradiction: Edmond Dantès said it was "difficult to prove", Little Sunshine "confirms".
False certainty: The "confirmation" is fabricated to justify the block.
Coordination: The hardening follows the already documented pattern.
sub4_1Title: 4.1 Art. 138 of the Penal Code - Slander

slanderTable.description: Art. 138 - To slander someone, falsely imputing to them an act defined as a crime
Crime of threat (Art. 147 of the Penal Code)
Detention of 6 months to 2 years + fine
Accusation made publicly on a global platform

slanderConclusionText: Chronus falsely imputed to the user the crime of threat (Art. 147 of the Penal Code) without presenting any evidence of the allegedly sent emails. The accusation was made publicly, in a verification request, constituting consummated slander. The penalty is detention of 6 months to 2 years, plus a fine. The fact that the accusation was made on a global platform aggravates the penalty.
sub4_2Title: 4.2 Art. 339 of the Penal Code - Malicious Denunciation
sub4_2Text1: In addition to slander, the conduct of Chronus and Little Sunshine also constitutes malicious denunciation (Art. 339 of the Penal Code):

maliciousTable.description: Art. 339 - To cause the initiation of an investigation against someone, imputing to them a crime they know they are innocent of

section5Title: 5. The Absence of Evidence for the Accusation
allegedList: Accusation: WazzimaGiygg allegedly sent threatening emails to Chronus.
missingList: The emails: Chronus did not present any email.
Sending records: There are no logs or proof.
Forensic analysis: No technical analysis was performed.
Police report: Chronus did not file a police report.
noEvidenceWarningText: Chronus falsely accused the user of the crime of threat without presenting a single piece of evidence. There are no emails, no records, no witnesses, no forensic analysis. The accusation is completely unfounded and constitutes slander in its most serious form.
victimConsequencesList: Reputational damage: The public accusation of the crime of threat stained the user's reputation.
SEO damage: The accusation is indexed in search engines.
Global block: The slander served as justification for the 4-minute block.
Psychological damage: The false accusation caused suffering and anxiety.
Isolation: The user was excluded from the community they contributed to.
agentConsequencesList: Criminal liability: Chronus and Little Sunshine may be held liable for slander and malicious denunciation.
Civil liability: They may be ordered to compensate the victim for moral damages.
Administrative liability: They may be removed from their positions on Wikipedia.
Credibility damage: The exposure of the slander harms the agents' credibility.

timelineTable.action: Admission of off-wiki monitoring. Linked the WazzimaGiygg account to Pedro Henrique Peres's civil name.
Global block in 4 minutes without adversarial proceedings.
Opens request against "Senhorvinte", exposing personal name and falsely accusing of email threats.
Replies "Possible, difficult to prove with certainty"
Formal complaint of Doxxing and device fingerprinting

section8Title: 8. Analysis of Coordination to Validate Slander
coordConclusionText: The coordination is evident and documented. Chronus falsely accuses, Edmond Dantès gives a cautious analysis (but does not contest the accusation), and Little Sunshine "hardens" the conclusion to justify the block. It is a repeated pattern that demonstrates systemic coordination to neutralize the user.
recommendationsList: Criminal Action: Filing of action against Chronus for slander (Art. 138 of the Penal Code) and against Chronus and Little Sunshine for malicious denunciation (Art. 339 of the Penal Code).
Civil Action: Claim for compensation for moral damages for the false accusation and public exposure.
Notification to WMF: Formal communication to the Wikimedia Foundation about the slander and the coordination to validate it.
Demotion: Immediate removal of Chronus, Edmond Dantès and Little Sunshine from all administrative positions.
Public Retraction: Demand for public retraction by Chronus, acknowledging the falsity of the accusation.
Review of Blocks: Review of all blocks based on false accusations.
section10Title: 10. Conclusion: Slander as an Instrument of Persecution
finalText1: The false accusation of email threats is one of the most serious episodes of slander documented in the WazzimaGiygg case. Chronus falsely imputed to the user the crime of threat without presenting any evidence, constituting consummated slander.
finalText2: The coordination between Chronus, Edmond Dantès and Little Sunshine to validate the slander demonstrates a systemic pattern of abuse where administrators and checkusers act together to neutralize critical users.
finalText3: Slander is an instrument of persecution used to destroy the victim's reputation and justify arbitrary sanctions. The total absence of evidence and the coordination to validate the accusation reveal the criminal nature of the conduct of the agents involved.
